=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Keep older-line findings blocking after guard deletions unless automated provenance analysis proves the deleted control cannot affect the cited operation."
  Expected change site: scripts/security_audit.sh, paths_mentioning() and deletion_block_reason()
  Evidence of absence: The implementation performs text-based module-name searches at base and head (via `paths_mentioning()`), checks for shared referrers, and checks if project-changed files reference the cited module. When these searches succeed without finding references, `deletion_block_reason()` returns `"", False`, marking the finding advisory. However, a successful `git grep` with no matches does not "prove" the deleted control cannot affect the operation—it only proves there is no static text reference. Indirect wiring (dynamic imports via `importlib.import_module()`, configuration-driven wiring, dependency injection, or multi-hop indirect references) would not be detected by text search. The requirement uses the word "proves," which implies a higher standard of certainty than text-based evidence provides. The implementation fails closed when searches fail (returns None), which is correct, but when searches succeed without matches, it marks findings advisory without exhaustive proof. This is a design limitation: text-based analysis is a practical heuristic but cannot rule out all possible indirect wiring paths.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
